title: Emergency Numbers and Official Websites to Save
summary: The helpline numbers and official websites to save on your phone, and where to get free legal help.

body.text: In an emergency, one number reaches the police, fire service and ambulance anywhere in India. Save that number today. Also save the helplines and official websites below.

items: 112: police, fire and ambulance (one number for all emergencies).
1098: Childline (for children who need care and protection)
nalsa.gov.in - free legal help and who can get it.
echallan.parivahan.gov.in - check and pay traffic fines.

body.text: 112 is one emergency number for all of India. On many smartphones, you can also call it by pressing the power button five times.
Calls to these helplines are free. If you are not comfortable, you do not have to tell your name.
These numbers are only for real emergencies. Using them wrongly wastes time that someone else may need.

practicalSteps: Save 112 and the helplines you need on your phone today.
Teach children and elders how to dial 112.
Type the official website address yourself. Do not click links in messages.
For free legal help, contact your District Legal Services Authority.
exceptions: Some states have extra local helplines. Check your state's official website.
How fast help arrives can differ by place. So give a clear address and a landmark (a known spot nearby).

faqs.q: Do these numbers work without balance?
faqs.a: The emergency number 112 works in many cases even without balance or a SIM. The helplines are free to call.

faqs.q: Can I call 112 for a non-emergency?
faqs.a: No. 112 is only for emergencies. For complaints, use the right helpline or your police station.

misconceptions.myth: I need the local police station number to get help fast.
misconceptions.fact: Dialling 112 connects you to emergency services anywhere in India.
